entities.name: Apply the open semantic system design lens
entities.summary: Make epistemic state, typed speech acts, derived artifacts, effect protocols, returned observations, bounded autonomy, and orthogonal graphs explicit during design.

acceptance: Changed design contracts use the open-system worksheet and declare warranted state
Typed inputs, artifacts, effect requests, observations, ownership, and bounded liveness remain distinct
The design-lens gate validates required shape without claiming prose meaning
Primary prior art and operator conversation remain provenance rather than semantic authority
